pr_title: Improve skin stable import behaviour to better handle similar skins
pr_body:
There have been multiple reports from users that they either can't find their skins imported from stable, or are noticing that not all skins have been imported.

The reasoning for "can't find skin" case is that users are used to stable *always* showing the directory name of skins, rather than the name in the `skin.ini` metadata. Meanwhile on lazer, we always prefer the metadata.

The reasoning for the "skin wasn't imported" case is that we are hashing based on `skin.ini` metadata, meaning if the user has made multiple local copies of the same skin but not updated the `skin.ini` (this is very common) only one of those skins would have been imported.

To resolve both of these issues, the folder name is now considered (and appended to) the metadata name.

Potential drawbacks with this PR:
- the name may be duplicated with slight variations ie. based on url encoding of the downloaded filename when the user originally loaded the skin into stable.
- for users which have already imported from stable once, some skins may be duplicated. this can of course be fixed by deleting and reimporting once.



Before:

![20210823 203851 (dotnet)](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/191335/130441126-696a6b0b-bf76-4a48-a94f-53a93532cbd7.png)

After:

![20210823 203802 (dotnet)](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/191335/130441040-8d759012-780b-4b30-8dd9-e18a276d1b8e.png)

Closes https://github.com/ppy/osu/issues/14451.

issue_context.title: Missing skins when importing from stable
issue_context.body:
**Describe the bug:** when importing skins from stable, it doesn't import all the skins, there are missing ones.

**Screenshots or videos showing encountered issue:** 

My osu! skins folder:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/38665405/130366679-377252ae-c40b-44e1-9820-399ffcea5b8e.png)

osu!lazer skins: (no scrollbar)
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/38665405/130366703-14cd3f57-1f09-4a84-9d36-b26b7e5e1b26.png)

**osu!lazer version:** 2021.820.0

**Logs:** 
[logs.zip](https://github.com/ppy/osu/files/7027962/logs.zip)
comments:
I've discovered something: the skins "White Circles" and "White Circles XD" had the same skin.ini file.
I changed the skin.ini file for one of them, and now it imported both.

The log contains the following:

```
2021-08-22 18:40:03 [verbose]: [405c4] Found existing but failed re-use check.
2021-08-22 18:40:03 [verbose]: [405c4] Import successfully completed!
```

Which means that indeed, the `skin.ini` files must have been completely identical, so the skins were deemed to be the same one skin. This was an optimisation applied to speed up skin import times.

I guess for now the solution is to make the skins distinct from each other by making `skin.ini` changes. This could also be communicated to the user more clearly.

This isn't the first time this has come up. We may want to reconsider how we're doing the duplicate detection (when migrating from stable) to also include the directory. It's kind of implied that the user expects each of the skins to be their own non-duplicate instances when performing a migration.

review_comments:
Although osu!stable exports skin archives using the metadata's name and author, I'm wondering about the case where a user imports a skin downloaded online. 

It'll appear in their list with the metadata name only (which in the video case, was a very weird name, "New Noel (shouyou dlwnstns)")

https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/22781491/130476026-cc473ea3-6b87-4ac3-b632-eee41e7c26c4.mp4

unlike osu!stable which uses the archive's filename for the skin instead.

I think it'll be more correct to specify the archive name in all ways of importing, in that case.
I intentionally opted not to do this. Skins downloaded should have correct metadata. If they don't, that's a separate issue which we can deal with separately.

But that means one could hit the same issue as in the thread, but with `.osk`s rather than direct stable imports. It is technically a different issue and potentially debatable, but thought it may be worth mentioning it here.

I don't really have a strong opinion on this but I'll just link https://github.com/ppy/osu/issues/10115, as it is a prior issue report that explicitly requests for skin metadata to be used for de-duplicating purposes (i.e. in case of skin updates), which seems relevant in the skin drag & drop case.
Keep in mind the main request there was for overwriting existing, which we still don't really handle "correctly". I don't think this PR changes their use case much.

Yeah, and my suggestion is only to allow displaying a "more readable" name next to the metadata name, so that the user is aware where the skin is on the dropdown when importing from online. But I've been testing with one popular skin only, so I've grep'd all names and authors of the skins I had, and it doesn't seem *that* bad to use metadata name on osk import only:
